title: Klavier Abend
CrePrimaryInscriptions: Handwritten on the front cover are the words, "Peter Stadlen Klavier Abend," translating to "Peter Stadlen Piano Evening."
PhyMedium: Pencil, ink and watercolour on paper
CreSecondaryInscriptions:
Inside writing:
"PROGRAMM / Peter Stadlen (Klavier) /
1) L. van Beethoven: Sonate As-dur Op. 26
Andante von Variazioni Scherzo (Allegro molto) (Sualla morte d'un Eroe) Allegro
2) Frederick Chopin: 24 Preludes
3) Igor Strawisky: Trois mouvements de Petrouchka
a)	Dance Russe
b)	Chez Petrouchka
c)	La semine grasse"
CreCreationNotes: This music programme was made by Fabian Erwin, for the concert of the pianist Peter Stadlen. Fabian was a graphic design artist during and after the war. He returned to England where he continued to work as a graphic and industrial artist but came back to Melbourne in 1960. He later became a successful and respect sculptor, whose work is represented in the National Gallery of Victoria, the High Court and Parliament House.
